## Summary
Build the exam deployment endpoint that makes an assembled exam available to students, and a QTI 2.1 export service that produces standards-compliant XML packages for interoperability with external LMS platforms.

## User story
As a faculty member, I want to deploy an assembled exam so students can take it, and export it as QTI 2.1 XML so I can import it into Canvas or other LMS platforms if needed.

## Why this matters
Without deployment, assembled exams exist only as data — students cannot take them. Without QTI 2.1 export, MSM is locked into Journey OS with no interoperability path, which is a risk for LCME accreditation reviews that may require data portability. Invalid QTI XML fails silently on import to Canvas/Blackboard, wasting faculty time.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] POST /api/exams/[id]/deploy changes assembly status to 'deployed' and creates exam session window
- [ ] Deploy requires assembly status = 'draft' (cannot re-deploy already deployed exam)
- [ ] Deploy sets: start_time, end_time, duration_minutes on the exam
- [ ] GET /api/exams/[id]/export returns QTI 2.1 XML package as downloadable .zip
- [ ] QTI package contains: imsmanifest.xml, assessmentTest.xml, one assessmentItem.xml per question
- [ ] QTI XML validates against IMS QTI 2.1 schema (well-formed + valid structure)
- [ ] Each assessmentItem includes: stem, answer choices (A-E), correct answer, Bloom metadata
- [ ] Export strips internal IDs — uses sequential numbering for external consumption
- [ ] API returns 403 for non-faculty roles
- [ ] API returns 404 for nonexistent exam

## API contract
```
POST /api/exams/[id]/deploy
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Request: {
  start_time: string (ISO 8601),
  end_time: string (ISO 8601),
  duration_minutes: number
}
Response: {
  data: {
    id: string,
    status: 'deployed',
    start_time: string,
    end_time: string,
    duration_minutes: number,
    deployed_at: string
  },
  error: null
}

GET /api/exams/[id]/export?format=qti21
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response: application/zip (QTI 2.1 package)
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="exam-{id}.qti.zip"
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/coverage-blueprint/services/QtiExportService.ts
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server'

interface QtiItem {
  identifier: string       // sequential: ITEM_001, ITEM_002, ...
  title: string
  stem: string
  choices: Array<{ id: string; text: string }>
  correct_response: string
  bloom_level: number
}

export class QtiExportService {
  async exportToQti21(assemblyId: string): Promise<Buffer> {
    const supabase = createServerClient()

    // 1. Load assembly + items from Supabase
    const { data: assembly } = await supabase
      .from('exam_assemblies')
      .select('*, exam_assembly_items(*)')
      .eq('id', assemblyId)
      .single()

    // 2. Load full item content for each assembly item
    // 3. Build QTI XML documents
    const manifest = this.buildManifest(assembly!)
    const testXml = this.buildAssessmentTest(assembly!)
    const itemXmls = assembly!.exam_assembly_items.map(
      (item: any, i: number) => this.buildAssessmentItem(item, i + 1)
    )

    // 4. Package as zip
    return this.createZipPackage(manifest, testXml, itemXmls)
  }

  private buildAssessmentItem(item: any, seq: number): string {
    return `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<assessmentItem xmlns="http://www.imsglobal.org/xsd/imsqti_v2p1"
  identifier="ITEM_${String(seq).padStart(3, '0')}"
  title="Question ${seq}"
  adaptive="false"
  timeDependent="false">
  <responseDeclaration identifier="RESPONSE" cardinality="single" baseType="identifier">
    <correctResponse><value>${item.correct_response}</value></correctResponse>
  </responseDeclaration>
  <itemBody>
    <choiceInteraction responseIdentifier="RESPONSE" shuffle="true" maxChoices="1">
      <prompt>${item.stem}</prompt>
      <!-- choices -->
    </choiceInteraction>
  </itemBody>
</assessmentItem>`
  }
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Rule 6: Neo4j write before Supabase on deploy
await neo4jQuery('MATCH (e:ExamAssembly {id: $id}) SET e.status = "deployed"')
await supabase.from('exam_assemblies').update({ status: 'deployed' })
// WRONG — Supabase first, Neo4j second

// ✗ Including internal UUIDs in QTI export
identifier="${item.uuid}"  // WRONG — use sequential ITEM_001 for portability

// ✗ Generating QTI without XML escaping
<prompt>${item.stem}</prompt>  // WRONG if stem contains < > & characters
// Must XML-escape all user content
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E06/E06-S05.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'

const BASE = process.env.BASE_URL ?? 'http://localhost:3000'

test('Acceptance: POST /api/exams/[id]/deploy sets status to deployed', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/exams/${process.env.TEST_ASSEMBLY_ID}/deploy`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: {
      start_time: '2026-04-15T09:00:00Z',
      end_time: '2026-04-15T11:00:00Z',
      duration_minutes: 120
    }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const { data } = await res.json()
  expect(data.status).toBe('deployed')
  expect(data.deployed_at).toBeTruthy()
})

test('Acceptance: GET /api/exams/[id]/export returns zip', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/exams/${process.env.TEST_ASSEMBLY_ID}/export?format=qti21`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200)
  const contentType = res.headers()['content-type']
  expect(contentType).toContain('application/zip')
  const disposition = res.headers()['content-disposition']
  expect(disposition).toContain('.qti.zip')
})

test('Acceptance: QTI package contains manifest and items', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get(`${BASE}/api/exams/${process.env.TEST_ASSEMBLY_ID}/export?format=qti21`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` }
  })
  const buffer = await res.body()
  // Unzip and verify contents
  const AdmZip = (await import('adm-zip')).default
  const zip = new AdmZip(buffer)
  const entries = zip.getEntries().map(e => e.entryName)
  expect(entries).toContain('imsmanifest.xml')
  expect(entries.some(e => e.startsWith('assessmentTest'))).toBe(true)
  expect(entries.some(e => e.includes('ITEM_001'))).toBe(true)
})

test('Negative: re-deploy already deployed exam returns error', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/exams/${process.env.TEST_DEPLOYED_ASSEMBLY_ID}/deploy`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_FACULTY_TOKEN}` },
    data: {
      start_time: '2026-04-20T09:00:00Z',
      end_time: '2026-04-20T11:00:00Z',
      duration_minutes: 120
    }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(400)
})

test('Negative: non-faculty gets 403', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.post(`${BASE}/api/exams/${process.env.TEST_ASSEMBLY_ID}/deploy`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.TEST_STUDENT_TOKEN}` },
    data: {
      start_time: '2026-04-15T09:00:00Z',
      end_time: '2026-04-15T11:00:00Z',
      duration_minutes: 120
    }
  })
  expect(res.status()).toBe(403)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `ALTER TABLE exam_assemblies DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS start_time, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS end_time, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS duration_minutes, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS deployed_at, DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS deployed_by;` then `pnpm db:types`
2. Remove files: `rm app/api/exams/\[id\]/deploy/route.ts app/api/exams/\[id\]/export/route.ts features/coverage-blueprint/services/QtiExportService.ts`
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
